title: CORE  of the EU DPP core ontology proposed by the CIRPASS-2 project.
description:

classes.label: Actor
classes.comment: Actor means a legal or natural person (e.g. John Doe, TNO). One actor can take on multiple roles; [CIRPASS-2 User Stories 3.1]

classes.label: Actor identifier
classes.comment: A type of identifier to identify Actors. A unique code assigned to Actor based on a scheme.

classes.label: Actor role assignment
classes.comment: Assigns a role to the actor in a particular context (DPP, Product, Event).

classes.label: Authorised representative role assignment
classes.comment: A specific assignment representing the written mandate between a manufacturer and an authorised representative; [ESPR Art 2 (43)]

classes.label: Background Database
classes.comment: Source representing a background LCI database used for the LCA modelling (e.g. ecoinvent, GaBi/Sphera, Okobaudat).

classes.label: Carbon Footprint
classes.comment:
An LCIAResult that "means the sum of greenhouse gas emissions and greenhouse gas removals in a product system, expressed as CO equivalents and based on a life cycle assessment using the single impact category of climate change". (ESPR Art 2 25))
 
It quantifies the global warming potential of a product over a 100-year time horizon.
Instances of this class quantify either the EN 15804+A2 individual "GWP-total - Global Warming Potential (total)" (ind_GWPtotal, an EN15804ImpactIndicator) or the EF 3.1 "Climate Change EF" indicator (ind_EF_climateChange, an LCIAImpactIndicator), depending on the reporting framework of the EPD or LCA study.

classes.label: Circular Economy Indicator
classes.comment:
Circular Economy indicators are measures for relevant monitoring the transition to a circular economy and to measure the effects of new policy and trends.

This class description needs to be extended/specialised according to the corresponding delegated acts or/and industry standards.

classes.label: ClassificationCode
classes.comment: A classification code from some product classification scheme .

classes.label: Common Specification
classes.comment: Common specification means ecodesign requirements, essential requirements for digital product passports or test, measurement or calculation methods established by implementing acts adopted by the Commission for products covered by delegated acts pursuant to ESPR Article 4.

classes.label: Compliance Declaration
classes.comment: A statement that the LCA or EPD study complies with a given compliance system (typically ISO 14040/14044, ISO 14025, ISO 14067, ISO 21930, EN 15804+A2, or a PEFCR). The level of compliance (fully, partially, not compliant) is recorded via eudpp:complianceStatus.

classes.label: Compliance System
classes.comment: A standard or programme against which an LCA or EPD study is declared compliant, such as ISO 14040/14044, ISO 14025, ISO 14067, ISO 21930, EN 15804+A2, PEFCR programmes, or a specific programme operator's scheme.

classes.label: Concentration of the substance of concern
classes.comment: The concentration of the substances of concern, at the level of the product, its relevant components, or spare parts ESPR Art 7(5)

classes.label: Concentration range
classes.comment: A concentration reported as an interval with a minimum and a maximum numerical value. The measurement unit is provided through dpp:hasMeasurementUnit.

classes.label: Conformity Certificate
classes.comment: Conformity assessment certificate for a certification. The blue guide uses the term "cerficate of conformity". The ESPR uses "conformity certificate" as well as "certificate" and "approval decision".
classes.source: Commission notice The ‘Blue Guide’ on the implementation of EU product rules 2022 Annex 4, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=oj:JOC_2022_247_R_0001

classes.label: Destruction
classes.comment: The intentional damaging or discarding of a product and unsold products as waste, with the exception of discarding for the sole purpose of delivering the discarded product for preparing for reuse, including refurbishment or remanufacturing operations. ESPR Art 2(34) and Art 25(1).

classes.label: DigitalInstruction
classes.comment:
Digital instructions
mean instructions in digital format concerning the product (‘digital instructions’) in a language that can be easily understood. ESPR Art 27(7)
Digital instructions are ensured by manufacturers. These should also ensured by importers. (ESPR Art 29(4))

This class can be extended/specialised according to delegated acts or industry standards.

classes.label: Document
classes.comment: The document class describes the semantic representation of any instance of a document that might be required to be included into a digital product passport instance.

classes.label: Digital Product Passport (DPP)
classes.comment:
Digital Product Passport (DPP) means a set of data specific to a product that includes the information specified in the applicable
delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 4 and that is accessible via electronic means through a data carrier in accordance with Chapter III. (ESPR Art 2 (28))

classes.label: DPP Archival Event
classes.comment: An event corresponding to the archival or end-of-active-life management of a Digital Product Passport.

classes.label: DPP Creation Event
classes.comment: An event corresponding to the creation or initial issuance of a Digital Product Passport.

classes.label: DPP Event
classes.comment: An ESPR-level event concept representing an event that affects the existence, content, accessibility, update, correction, or governance of a DPP. A DPPEvent captures the passport-facing semantics of the occurrence and is modelled as distinct from the product event that may trigger it.

classes.label: DPP Event Record
classes.comment: A technical audit record used to represent and log an information-level event affecting a Digital Product Passport. Unlike EPCIS carriers, this class is intended for recording DPP-side information events rather than product-facing operational events.
classes.source: Defined in the EU DPP Core Ontology Event module to support the technical recording of DPP-related events.

classes.label: DPP identifier
classes.comment: A type of identifier to identify DPP. DPP Identifier.

classes.label: DPP Update Event
classes.comment: An event corresponding to an update of the content of a Digital Product Passport.

classes.label: Durability
classes.comment:
Durability
means the ability of a product to maintain over time its function and performance under specified conditions of use, maintenance and repair. (ESPR Art 2 (22))

This class description needs to be extended/specialised according to the corresponding delegated acts or/and industry standards.

classes.label: Emission to air
classes.comment:
Product parameters are listed in the ESPR Annex I :

(q) emissions to air, water or soil released in one or more lifecycle stages of the product as expressed through quantities and nature of emissions, including noise.

This class description needs to be extended/specialised according to the corresponding delegated acts or/and industry standards.

classes.label: Emission to soil
classes.comment:
Product parameters are listed in the ESPR Annex I :

(q) emissions to air, water or soil released in one or more lifecycle stages of the product as expressed through quantities and nature of emissions, including noise.

This class description needs to be extended/specialised according to the corresponding delegated acts or/and industry standards.

classes.label: Emission to water
classes.comment:
Product parameters are listed in the ESPR Annex I :

(q) emissions to air, water or soil released in one or more lifecycle stages of the product as expressed through quantities and nature of emissions, including noise.

This class description needs to be extended/specialised according to the corresponding delegated acts or/and industry standards.

classes.label: EN 15804 Indicator
classes.comment:
An indicator defined by EN 15804+A2 (core impact, impact with caveats, resource use, waste output, or output-flow indicator). 
Subclass of the abstract eudpp:LCAIndicator parent. 
Note: an EN15804Indicator individual is the indicator definition; a result computed for that indicator is an eudpp:LCAResult instance (LCIAResult or InventoryIndicatorResult sibling).

classes.label: Energy Consumption Result
classes.comment:
An LCA inventory indicator result quantifying the consumption of primary energy resources — renewable and non-renewable — in a product system. 
Commonly associated with the EN 15804+A2 primary energy indicators (e.g. PERE, PERM, PERT, PENRE, PENRM, PENRT), though no formal quantifiesIndicator restriction is imposed, as energy consumption may span multiple indicators depending on the study scope.

classes.label: Environmental emission
classes.comment:
Emission is the act or amount of sending out gas, heat, light, etc. It can also refer to harmful substances that are released into the environment, especially carbon dioxide.


This class description needs to be extended/specialised according to the corresponding delegated acts or/and industry standards.

classes.label: Environmental Footprint Score Result
classes.comment:
A normalized and weighted aggregate LCA result expressing the overall environmental performance of a product system as a single dimensionless score, computed by applying the Product Environmental Footprint (PEF) method (Recommendation (EU) 2021/2279). 
Aggregates the characterised results of all 16 EF 3.1 impact categories through normalization and weighting factors.
Instances of this class quantify the EF single score indicator (ind_EF_singleScore, an EnvironmentalFootprintScore individual) via quantifiesIndicator.

classes.label: Environmental pollution
classes.comment:
Environmental pollution is the addition of any substance or form of energy to the environment at a rate faster than it can be dispersed or safely stored.

This class description needs to be extended/specialised according to the corresponding delegated acts or/and industry standards.

classes.label: EPD Document
classes.comment: Source representing the published PDF or HTML EPD document itself (as distinct from the ILCD+EPD machine-readable EPDStudy).

classes.label: EPD Study
classes.comment: An LCA study that conforms to EN 15804+A2 with EF 3.1 characterisation, i.e. an Environmental Product Declaration. Inherits all study-level metadata from eudpp:LCAStudy (compliance declarations, manufacturer records, reviews, LCA results, etc.) and adds EPD-specific properties: ILCD+EPD format version (eudpp:epdFormatVersion), registration number, expiry date, reference to the published EPD document (eudpp:EPDDocument via referenceToOriginalEPD), reference to the applicable Product Category Rules (eudpp:PCR via referenceToPCR). EN 15804+A2 module values per LCAResult are used to populate per-life-cycle-module values. Replaces v1.9.4's mixed structure and v1.9.5's eudpp:EPDDataSet.

classes.label: ESPR Event
classes.comment: Abstract superclass introduced for modelling purposes. Used to represent the regulatory or business semantics of an event relevant in the ESPR context and concerning either a product or its DPP, independently of its technical journalisation.
classes.source: Regulation (EU) 2024/1781; lifecycle-event-oriented abstraction introduced for modelling purposes.

classes.label: EU Declaration of Conformity
classes.comment: The EU Declaration of Conformity shall state that the fulfilment of the ecodesign requirements specified in the applicable delegated acts adopted pursuant to ESPR Article 4 has been demonstrated or that a presumption of conformity applies in accordance with ESPR Article 41.
classes.source: Decision No 768/2008/EC Annex I Art R10, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/dec/2008/768(1)/oj#anx_I

classes.label: Facility
classes.comment: A Facility may be a place where specific activities occur. A production/manufacturing facility means a factory. The term may refer to any place that makes things, or plants that generate electricity.

classes.label: Facility identifier
classes.comment: A unique code assigned to a physical site (factory, warehouse, plant, school, hospital, etc.), i.e., identifies a location.

classes.label: Facility identifier scheme
classes.comment: A kind of identifier scheme. The scheme or standard used to identify Facilities.

classes.label: Harmonised Standard
classes.comment: Harmonised Standard means a European standard adopted on the basis of a request made by the Commission for the application of Union harmonisation legislation.

classes.label: Hazardous waste amount
classes.comment:
Hazardous waste amount of the product.

This class description needs to be extended/specialised according to the corresponding delegated acts or/and industry standards.

classes.label: Height
classes.comment: Height of the product

classes.label: Identifier
classes.comment:
Identifier. A general class to hold different kinds of identifiers described and used for EU DPP CO. Each sub-class of this class describes a different kind of identifier. Intentionally modelled as sub-classes. 
Identifiers have value, and a scheme/standard they are based on.

Cardinatlity restrictions added to each subclass to enforce inheritance of the data propertyy identifierValue.

classes.label: Identifier granularity
classes.comment: The granularity of the identifier. For example, for Products this could be model, batch, item.

classes.label: Identifier scheme
classes.comment: The scheme or standard used for Identifier.

classes.label: Impact Model
classes.comment: The characterisation model underlying an LCIA method (e.g. IPCC AR6 2021 for GWP). It carries a model name (eudpp:modelName), optional version (eudpp:modelVersion), and optional bibliographic source (eudpp:referenceToModelSource).

classes.label: Inventory Indicator Result
classes.comment:
A specific LCA result representing an aggregated inventory-indicator result computed for an EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator (Table 5: resource use, waste categories, output flows). 
Important disambiguation: this class represents the AGGREGATED inventory-indicator value (e.g. total kg of HWD across A1-A3 for one product), as printed in EN 15804+A2 EPD tables and computed by a Method instance. It is NOT the raw flow-level life-cycle inventory (LCI) result of a process (which would be a list of elementary-flow exchanges with amounts and units, and is out of scope for this DPP-oriented LCA module).

classes.label: Land Use Result
classes.comment:
An LCA result quantifying impacts associated with land occupation and transformation in a product system. 
Commonly associated with the EN 15804+A2 land use indicator (LU), which is characterised under EF 3.1. No formal quantifiesIndicator restriction is imposed; note that LU sits at the boundary between inventory and impact in EN 15804 and may be refined in future ontology versions.

classes.label: LCA Indicator
classes.comment:
Abstract umbrella class for an indicator definition (impact or inventory category) that an eudpp:Method calculates values for. 
Each instance identifies exactly one method under which it is computed; this constraint is formalised as owl:maxCardinality 1 on eudpp:computedByMethod. 
Note: an indicator individual is the indicator DEFINITION (e.g. "FW – Net use of fresh water, in m3"); a numerical value computed for that indicator on a specific study is an eudpp:LCAResult instance (LCIAResult or InventoryIndicatorResult).

classes.label: LCA Method
classes.comment:
A life-cycle assessement method that produces values for one indicator from an inventory of elementary flows. 
Covers both (a) characterised LCIA methods (which apply characterisation factors to compute a midpoint impact result), and (b) inventory aggregation methods (which sum / aggregate inventory flows to produce an inventory-indicator result, e.g. the EN 15804+A2 inventory indicators FW, HWD, PERE etc. defined as inventory-level by the standard's calculation rules).

classes.label: LCIA Method Report
classes.comment: Source that documents a life-cycle impact assessment (LCIA) method (e.g. the EF 3.1 method description).

classes.label: LCA Module Value
classes.comment:
One numerical LCA-result value (impact or inventory-indicator) for a specific EN 15804+A2 life-cycle module (A1-A3, A4, ..., D) and optionally a specific scenario. 
It carries eudpp:amount (the numeric value), eudpp:forLifeCycleModule, optionally eudpp:forScenario, and eudpp:isDeclared (boolean: true if the module is declared with this value; false if the module is explicitly not declared for this indicator).

classes.label: LCA Result
classes.comment:
Abstract class for any LCA computation output of a study. Has three subclasses: 
eudpp:LCIAResult (characterised impact result) which applies characterisation factors of an LCIA method, eudpp:InventoryIndicatorResult (aggregated inventory-indicator result) whcih is a sum/aggregation over the inventory without characterisation, and eudpp:EnvironmentalFootprintScoreResult which represents the aggregated EF single score result. 

In the regulatory sense of ESPR Art. 2(24), some characterized individuals of LCAResult constitute environmental footprints — quantifications of environmental impacts of a product throughout its life cycle.Other LCAResult instances, however, fall outside the strict ESPR definition. For this reason, LCAResult is linked to the ESPR "Environmental Footprint" concept via skos:broadMatch rather than owl:equivalentClass.

classes.label: LCA Study
classes.comment:
A life-cycle assessment study of a product, conducted per ISO 14040/14044, producing one or more LCA results. The general study container, applicable to any product whether or not the study follows EN 15804+A2. 
Carries study-level metadata (UUID, dataset version, name, reference year, license, copyright, ILCD format version, compliance declarations, manufacturer records, reviews, references to data sources / background databases / PEFCR, etc.). 
Cross-module link from a product to this class is provided by the Connector property eudpp:hasLCAStudy.

classes.label: LCIA Result
classes.comment: A characterised LCA result quantifying one LCIA indicator (an EN15804ImpactIndicator or an LCIAImpactIndicator ) for a product system. Each instance is linked to exactly one indicator individual via quantifiesIndicator, and carries its numerical value per life-cycle module via hasLCAModuleValue.

classes.label: Length
classes.comment: Length of the product

classes.label: Maintenance
classes.comment: Actions (one or more) taken to keep a product in a condition where it can fulfil its intended purpose. ESPR Art 2(19).

classes.label: Making Available on the Market
classes.comment: Any supply of a product for distribution, consumption or use on the Union market in the course of a commercial activity, whether in return for payment or free of charge. ESPR Art 2(39).

classes.label: Manufacturer Record
classes.comment: A container provenance entity (prov:Entity) documenting the involvement of a manufacturer (and optionally a data provider) in a specific LCA study, including the facility concerned and whether primary LCA data was provided.

classes.label: Material Footprint
classes.comment:
An InventoryIndicatorResult that "refers to the total amount of raw materials extracted to meet final consumption demands" (ESPR Art. 2(26)).

Modelled as an inventory-level result rather than a characterised LCIA result, as it aggregates raw material extraction flows without applying characterisation factors.
No single EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator individual is pinned via quantifiesIndicator; the link is left to individual instances, as material footprint spans multiple EN 15804+A2 resource use inventory indicators (PERE, PENRE, SM, RSF, NRSF, etc.).

classes.label: Material identifier
classes.comment: A type of identifier to identify materials. A unique code assigned to Material based on a scheme.

classes.label: Material of composition
classes.comment: Material the product (or component) is made of [ESPR Annex I]. Material as an element of composition.

classes.label: Material type
classes.comment:
Placeholder class for material type classification applicable in a sector or mandated by a delegated act (DA).

Potential types could be, on the example of textile sector: cotton, nylon, ...

classes.label: Maximum concentration
classes.comment: A concentration reported as a maximum value. The inherited dpp:numericalValue denotes the upper bound, and dpp:hasMeasurementUnit supplies its unit.

classes.label: Microplastic release
classes.comment:
Product parameters as listed in the ESPR Annex I :

(p) microplastic and nano plastic release as expressed through the release during relevant
product life cycle stages, including manufacturing, transport, use and end of life stages;

This class description needs to be extended/specialised according to the corresponding delegated acts or/and industry standards.

classes.label: Nanoplastic release
classes.comment:
Product parameters as listed in the ESPR Annex I :

(p) microplastic and nano plastic release as expressed through the release during relevant
product life cycle stages, including manufacturing, transport, use and end of life stages;

This class description needs to be extended/specialised according to the corresponding delegated acts or/and industry standards.

classes.label: Natural Person
classes.comment: A human being as distinguished from a person (as a corporation) created by operation of law

classes.label: Other Technical Specification
classes.comment: Other technical specifications in relation to which conformity is declared.

classes.label: Packaging waste amount
classes.comment:
Packaging waste amount of the product.

This class description needs to be extended/specialised according to the corresponding delegated acts or/and industry standards.

classes.label: Product Category Rules (PCR)
classes.comment: Source that is a Product Category Rules document (EN 15804+A2 Table 2 Line 1). Used in EN 15804+A2 EPDStudy via eudpp:referenceToPCR.

classes.label: Product Environmental Footprint Category Rules (PEFCR)
classes.comment: Source that is a Product Environmental Footprint Category Rules document, the European Commission Environmental Footprint methodology's product-category-specific rules. Parallel role to PCR but for PEF studies (rather than EN 15804+A2 EPD studies). Used by an LCAStudy via eudpp:referenceToPEFCR. NEW in v1.9.7.

classes.label: Placing on the Market
classes.comment: The very first time a product is made available on the Union market. ESPR Art 2(40).

classes.label: Plastic release
classes.comment:
Product parameters as listed in the ESPR Annex I :

(p) microplastic and nano plastic release as expressed through the release during relevant
product life cycle stages, including manufacturing, transport, use and end of life stages;

This class description needs to be extended/specialised according to the corresponding delegated acts or/and industry standards.

classes.label: Plastics waste amount
classes.comment:
Hazardous waste amount of the product.

This class description needs to be extended/specialised according to the corresponding delegated acts or/and industry standards.

classes.label: Product
classes.comment: Product means any physical goods that are placed on the market or put into service. ESPR Art 2 (1))

classes.label: Product dimension
classes.comment:
Dimension class covers measurements of length, width, height, volume, and weight of the product required by
ESPR Annex I in its product parameters

classes.label: Product Event
classes.comment: An ESPR-level event concept representing an event that affects the state, condition, use, circulation, transformation, maintenance, or end-of-life status of a product. A ProductEvent captures the product-facing semantics of the occurrence and is distinct from any DPP-side event that may be triggered to record or reflect it.

classes.label: Product identifier
classes.comment: A type of identifier to identify Products. A unique code assigned to identify a product. e.g., GTIN.

classes.label: Product Requirement
classes.comment: Product requirements means a requirement to be fullfilled by a product when placed on the market.

classes.label: Product Status
classes.comment: Represents the current lifecycle status of a product.

classes.label: Product to packaging ratio
classes.comment:
ESPR Annex I, the list of product parameters includes the parameter called the  product to packaging ratio.

However, it is not specified in ESPR  whether that ratio is defined on the basis of weight or on the basis of volume.

**This class description needs to be extended/specialised according to the corresponding delegated acts or/and industry standards.**

classes.label: Property
classes.comment: A property of the product.

classes.label: Putting into Service
classes.comment: The first use of a product for its intended purpose in the Union. ESPR Art 2(41).

classes.label: Quality indicator
classes.comment:
Product characteristics like durability and reliability.

This class description needs to be extended/specialised according to the corresponding delegated acts or/and industry standards.

classes.label: Quantitative Property
classes.comment: A property (respectively measurand of a property) of the product (model) that is expressed by a quantity value. A specific quantity.

classes.label: Recoverable rate
classes.comment: This class description needs to be extended/specialised according to the corresponding delegated acts or/and industry standards.

classes.label: Recycled Materials Use Result
classes.comment:
An LCA inventory indicator result quantifying the use of secondary (recycled) material inputs in a product system. 
Commonly associated with the EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator “Use of secondary material” (SM), though no formal quantifiesIndicator restriction is imposed.

classes.label: Recycling collection rate
classes.comment: This class description needs to be extended/specialised according to the corresponding delegated acts or/and industry standards.

classes.label: Recycling rate
classes.comment: This class description needs to be extended/specialised according to the corresponding delegated acts or/and industry standards.

classes.label: Refurbishment
classes.comment: Actions carried out to prepare, clean, test, service and, where necessary, repair a product or a discarded product in order to restore its performance or functionality within the intended use and range of performance originally conceived at the design stage at the time of the placing of the product on the market. ESPR Art 2(18).

classes.label: Reliability
classes.comment:
Reliability
means the probability that a product functions as required under given conditions for a given
duration without an occurrence which results in a primary or secondary function of the product no
longer being performed. (ESPR Art 2 (16))

Reliability is usually expressed in terms of mean time between failures (MTBF), which is the average length of time that a device will operate without failure.

This class description needs to be extended/specialised according to the corresponding delegated acts or/and industry standards.

classes.label: Remanufacturing
classes.comment: Actions through which a new product is produced from objects that are waste, products or components and through which at least one change is made that substantially affects the safety, performance, purpose or type of the product. ESPR Art 2(16).

classes.label: Repair
classes.comment: Actions taken to return a defective product or waste to a condition where it fulfils its intended purpose. ESPR Art 2(20).

classes.label: Review
classes.comment: A verification / critical review performed on an LCA study or EPD study.

classes.label: Review Report
classes.comment: Source holding the complete critical-review / verification report referenced from a Review.

classes.label: Substance of concern identifier
classes.comment: A type of identifier to identify substances of concern.

classes.label: SoC qualification assertion
classes.comment: A documented, explicit assertion that a substance satisfies one or more non-exclusive qualification criteria in ESPR Article 2(27). For criterion (d), the applicable product context is represented by a dpp:SubstancePresence linked through dpp:hasApplicableQualification. This modelling construct records asserted qualification evidence; it does not infer legal status.

classes.label: Source
classes.comment: A bibliographic or documentary source referenced from an LCA study, EPD study or LCIA Method. Abstract superclass; concrete source instances typically use one of the more specific subclasses (PCR, LCAMethodReport, BackgroundDatabase, ComplianceSystem, ReviewReport, EPDDocument).

classes.label: Substance
classes.comment: A chemical substance used as the generic superclass for substance identity and naming information. In this SOC module it primarily supports the modelling of dpp:SubstanceOfConcern; its presence does not make SOC a general-purpose substance-reporting module.

classes.label: substance identifier
classes.comment: A type of identifier to identify substances. A unique code assigned to substance based on a scheme.

classes.label: Substance management instruction
classes.comment: An instruction concerning the management of a substance of concern in its SubstancePresence context, including safe use, disassembly, preparation for reuse, reuse, recycling and environmentally sound end-of-life management. This domain-specific modelling abstraction supports the information elements in ESPR Article 7(5)(d)-(e); it is not a term defined by the Regulation and does not determine legal obligations or applicability.

classes.label: Substance of concern
classes.comment: A substance that: (a) meets the criteria laid down in Article 57 of Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 and is identified in accordance with Article 59(1) of that Regulation; (b) is classified in Part 3 of Annex VI to Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008 in one of the following hazard classes or hazard categories: (i) carcinogenicity categories 1 and 2; (ii) germ cell mutagenicity categories 1 and 2; (iii) reproductive toxicity categories 1 and 2; (iv) endocrine disruption for human health categories 1 and 2; (v) endocrine disruption for the environment categories 1 and 2; (vi) persistent, mobile and toxic or very persistent, very mobile properties; (vii) persistent, bioaccumulative and toxic or very persistent, very bioaccumulative properties; (viii) respiratory sensitisation category 1; (ix) skin sensitisation category 1; (x) hazardous to the aquatic environment — categories chronic 1 to 4; (xi) hazardous to the ozone layer; (xii) specific target organ toxicity — repeated exposure categories 1 and 2; (xiii) specific target organ toxicity — single exposure categories 1 and 2; (c) is regulated under Regulation (EU) 2019/1021; or (d) negatively affects the reuse and recycling of materials in the product in which it is present.

classes.label: Substance presence
classes.comment: A contextual relation entity representing the presence of a substance in relation to a product as placed on the market, including a product, component or spare part. It enables product-dependent location, concentration and instruction information to be represented without treating those data as intrinsic characteristics of the substance itself or classifying the presence as a product property. In the CORE profile the modelling pattern is one SubstancePresence per reported location when different locations require different concentrations; sector-specific extensions may provide explicit reference bases for several calculation perspectives. This class is an ontology modelling abstraction supporting ESPR Article 7(5), rather than a term explicitly defined by the Regulation.

classes.label: Sustainable Renewable Materials Use Result
classes.comment:
An LCA inventory indicator result quantifying the use of renewable secondary material and fuel inputs in a product system. 
Commonly associated with the EN 15804+A2 inventory indicators “Use of renewable secondary fuels” (RSF) or “Use of non-renewable secondary fuels” (NRSF), though no formal quantifiesIndicator restriction is imposed, as the scope of renewable material inputs may evolve.

classes.label: Technical Specification
classes.comment: Technical specification means a document that prescribes technical requirements to be fulfilled by a product, process, service or system and which lays down one or more of the following: Common Specification or Other Technical Specification.

classes.label: Threshold of substance of concern
classes.comment:
Relevant threshold of Substance of Concern.

By default, information on all substances of concern present in a product, above the  relevant thresholds, should be included in the DPP [ESPR FAQ 10.115, p59]

classes.label: Union Harmonised Legislation
classes.comment: Union Harmonisation Legislation shall mean any Union legislation harmonising the conditions for the marketing of products. Examples are directives, regulations and delegated acts.
classes.source:
Decision No 768/2008/EC Annex I Art R1 (17)
https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/dec/2008/768(1)/oj#anx_I

classes.label: Upgrading
classes.comment: Actions carried out to enhance the functionality, performance, capacity, safety or aesthetics of a product. ESPR Art 2(17).

classes.label: Volume
classes.comment: Volume of the product

classes.label: Waste generation amount
classes.comment:
Waste generation amount of the product.

This class description needs to be extended/specialised according to the corresponding delegated acts or/and industry standards.

classes.label: Water Consumption Result
classes.comment:
An LCA inventory indicator result quantifying the net consumption of fresh water resources in a product system. 
This class is typically associated with the EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator “Use of net fresh water” (FW), though no formal quantifiesIndicator restriction is imposed to allow for future indicator additions or revised indicator frameworks.

classes.label: Weight
classes.comment: Weight of the product

classes.label: Width
classes.comment: Width of the product

properties.label: Abbreviation
properties.comment: An abbreviation used for the substance.

properties.label: access restrictions
properties.comment: Human-readable description of access and use restrictions for the LCA / EPD study (equivalent to dcterms:accessRights).

properties.label: according to
properties.comment: Property defining specifies conformity assess procedure/cerfication scheme underlying the cerfificate.

properties.label: actor name
properties.comment: Name of an actor.

properties.label: addresses AoP
properties.comment:
Link between an LCIAImpactCategory and the Area(s)-of-protection it addresses.
1..n cardinality: a single impact category can address several Areas of Protection — for example, ozone depletion affects both Natural Environment and Human Health.

properties.label: allows Conformity Assessment Module
properties.comment: A property that specifies the conformity assment procedure applicable to the type of product

properties.label: amount
properties.comment: Numerical value of an LCA result or an LCIAModuleValue.

properties.label: applies to product
properties.comment: The property links DPP and the Product.

properties.label: assesses impact category
properties.comment: Link from an LCIA impact indicator to the mid-point impact category it characterises. Multiple indicators may assess the same category (e.g. Eutrophication, freshwater and Eutrophication, marine both relate to Eutrophication). This property expresses a conceptual classification link, not equivalence.

properties.label: assigned ELI
properties.comment: Standardised identification that makes it easier to identify and describe legislation across Europe.

properties.label: assignment valid from
properties.comment: The date and time from which the actor role assignment is valid.

properties.label: assignment valid to
properties.comment: The date and time until which the actor role assignment is valid.

properties.label: belongs to EN 15804 indicator group
properties.comment: Link from an EN15804Indicator individual to the indicator EN15804IndicatorGroup it belongs to (core impact, with-caveats, resource use, waste, valorisation, exported energy).

properties.label: belongs to methodology
properties.comment: Link from a Method to one or several LCAMethodology individuals it belongs to (e.g. eudpp:methodology_EF3_1). Cardinality 1..n: a single method can be classified into more than one methodology (for example, when two methodologies share the same characterisation factors for one indicator).

properties.label: CAS name
properties.comment: The Chemical Abstracts Service name of the substance, when available.

properties.label: CAS number
properties.comment: The Chemical Abstracts Service registry number of the substance, when available.

properties.label: certificate number
properties.comment: Number of the certificate

properties.label: certificate revision number
properties.comment: Number of the revision of a certificate

properties.label: classification code set
properties.comment:
The product classification code set.

See also Produc hasProductGroup ClassificationCode documentation.

properties.label: classification code value
properties.comment: Classification code value from the Classification code set.

properties.label: commodity code
properties.comment: Relevant commodity codes, such as a TARIC code as defined in Council Regulation (EEC) No 2658/87.[ESPR Annex III (d)]

properties.label: computed by method
properties.comment:
Link from an LCAIndicator individual to the IndicatorMethod instance that describes how this indicator is computed — its impact model, impact category, methodology reference, reference report, and ILCD method metadata. 
Cardinality: at most 1 per indicator individual."

properties.label: concerns DPP
properties.comment:
Links a DPP event to the Digital Product Passport whose content, state, or accessibility is affected by the event. This is a cross-module relation between EVENT and P_DPP and is therefore managed in the Connector/mapping layer.

DPP is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.
DPPEvent is modelled in the EU DPP CO EVENT module.

properties.label: concerns product
properties.comment:
Links a product event to the product whose state, condition, or lifecycle is affected by the event. This is a cross-module relation between EVENT and P_DPP and is therefore managed in the Connector/mapping layer.

Product is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.
ProductEvent is modelled in the EU DPP CO EVENT module.

properties.label: Concerns substance
properties.comment: Links a reported SubstancePresence to the SubstanceOfConcern involved. dpp:Substance remains the superclass used for generic substance identity and naming properties, but the SOC reporting relation itself is intentionally restricted to dpp:SubstanceOfConcern.

properties.label: conformity attested by
properties.comment:
Specifies the notified body that attests the product's conformity with Union harmonisation legislation. 

UnionHarmonisationLegislation is modelled in the EU DPP CO COMP module.
Actor is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: conformity declared to
properties.comment: A property which specifies which Union Harmonisation Legislation conformity is declared to.

properties.label: contains substance of concern
properties.comment:
Linking the product to a substance of concern the product contains.

Product is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.
Substance of concern is modelled in the EU DPP CO SOC module.

properties.label: content type
properties.comment: Content type of a document. Can be only “application” or “pdf”.

properties.label: country of origin
properties.comment:
Represents customs/regulatory country of origin, which may be distinct from facility location. 

Note: not specified by ESPR, requested by sectors (reasoning: country of origin must not be inferred automatically from facility country).

Recommended ISO 3166-1 country codes.

properties.label: data set version
properties.comment: Version number of this LCA / EPD study instance, independent of the ontology version. Format: major.minor.sub-minor (e.g. "02.00.011").

properties.label: declares Manufacturer Record
properties.comment: Links an LCA study to a manufacturer record documenting the manufacturers whose data is included in the study.

properties.label: description
properties.comment: Product description

properties.label: dictionary reference
properties.comment:
The reference to the unique identifier of the data point specification defined in the repository/data dictionary.

It is formatted as a URI/URL .

properties.label: DPP backup URL
properties.comment: Fallback URL providing direct access to Digital Product Passport data in case the primary provider becomes unavailable.

properties.label: dpp event recorded at
properties.comment: The date and time at which the technical record of a DPP event was created in an information system or audit trail.

properties.label: dpp event record identifier
properties.comment: A unique identifier assigned to a DPP event record.

properties.label: DPP schema version
properties.comment: The reference standard the DPP instance schema refers to.

properties.label: DPP status
properties.comment: The status of the DPP instance as digital resource.

properties.label: DPP URL
properties.comment: Provides the HTTP/URI endpoint to access the live DPP.

properties.label: ECHA number
properties.comment: A number assigned to the substance by the European Chemicals Agency, when available and appropriate.

properties.label: EC number
properties.comment: The European Community number indicated in EINECS, ELINCS or the No Longer Polymer list, when available and appropriate.

properties.label: EPD format version
properties.comment: Version tag of the ILCD+EPD format used (e.g. "1.3").

properties.label: expiry date
properties.comment: Date on which the EPD's validity expires. EN 15804+A2 EPDs are typically valid for five years from publication.

properties.label: follows PCR
properties.comment: Link from an EPDStudy to the Product Category Rules document(s) it follows (1..n).

properties.label: follows PEFCR
properties.comment: Link from an LCAStudy to a Product Environmental Footprint Category Rules document (1..n).

properties.label: for life-cycle module
properties.comment: Link from an LCAModuleValue to the Life-cycle module it refers to.

properties.label: for scenario
properties.comment: Identifier of the scenario this LCIAModuleValue applies to (free-text label matching the EPD's scenario declaration).

properties.label: granularity
properties.comment:
ESPR Art 9 (2) d  declares that the digital product passport is to be established at model, batch or item level, and the definition of such levels (is determined by delegated acts (DA));

The product passport should be defined at the level of item, batch or product model, depending on specific needs and complexity of the value chain, the size, nature or impacts of the products considered. (Standardisation Request 5423 7)

properties.label: has actor
properties.comment: Links actor role assignment to actor

properties.label: has actor role assignment
properties.comment:
Links an event to an actor-role assignment that is valid in the context of that event. This is a cross-module relation between EVENT and ACTOR and is therefore managed in the Connector/mapping layer.

ESPREvent is modelled in the EU DPP CO EVENT module.
ActorRoleAssignment is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: has applicable qualification
properties.comment: Links a SubstancePresence to an applicable qualification assertion; criterion (d) context is presence-scoped.

properties.label: has authorised representative
properties.comment:
Specifies the natural or legal person established within the Union who has received a written mandate from a manufacturer to act on his behalf in relation to the Declaration of Conformity.

EUDeclarationOfConformity is modelled in the EU DPP CO COMP module.
Actor is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

Source: 
Decision No 768/2008/EC Annex I Art R1 (4)
https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/dec/2008/768(1)/oj#anx_I

ESPR Annex V (2,9)
https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/1781/oj/#anx_%C2%A0V

properties.label: has back-up-copy host
properties.comment:
The reference of the digital product passport service provider hosting the back-up copy of the digital product passport [ESPR Annex III].

DPP is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.
Actor is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: has compliance declaration
properties.comment: Link from an LCAStudy (or its subclass EPDStudy) to a ComplianceDeclaration. Compliance can be declared against any standard relevant to the study type (ISO 14040/14044, ISO 14025, ISO 14067, ISO 21930, EN 15804+A2, PEFCR-specific rules, etc.).

properties.label: has concentration
properties.comment:
Links a substance presence to concentration information. A concentration is contextual to the structural location identified by the associated SubstancePresence. 

Different product, component, or spare-part locations requiring different concentrations should normally use distinct SubstancePresence records. 

Exact, maximum, and range representations remain distinguished by the existing P_DPP/SOC concentration model.

ConcentrationOfSubstanceOfConcern is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.
SubstancePresence is modelled in the EU DPP CO IDENT module.

properties.label: has copyright
properties.comment: True if a copyright applies to the LCA / EPD study, false otherwise.

properties.label: has digital product passport id
properties.comment:
Realisation for the Unique identifier of an instance of the digital product passport.

DPP is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.
DPPIdentifier is modelled in the EU DPP CO IDENT module.

properties.label: Has disassembly instruction
properties.comment: Links a substance presence to information relevant for disassembly.

properties.label: has DPP
properties.comment: A Product has a DPP. The property links a Product with a DPP.

properties.label: has DPP action type
properties.comment: Links a DPP update event to the type of information-level action performed on the Digital Product Passport.

properties.label: has economic operator
properties.comment:
Linking the product to the economic operator (Actor from ACTOR module).

Product is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.
Actor is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: Has end-of-life management instruction
properties.comment: Links a substance presence to information relevant for environmentally sound management of the product at end-of-life.

properties.label: has EU Declaration of Conformity
properties.comment:
Specifies the EU declaration of conformity issued for the product.

EUDeclarationOfConformity is modelled in the EU DPP CO COMP module.
Product is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.

properties.label: has external source
properties.comment: Link from an LCAStudy to a background source. It can be a (a) documentation (e.g. an LCA project report, safety data sheet, or explanatory material) - covering the ILCD+EPD element referenceToExternalDocumentation on dataSetInformation, (b) databases or, (c)  literature sources used for modelling.

properties.label: has facility
properties.comment:
Links a product to a facility.

Product is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.
Facility is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: has granularity
properties.comment: Defines the granularity of an identifier, if exists.

properties.label: has impact category
properties.comment: Impact category addressed by the Method.

properties.label: has impact model
properties.comment: Link from an Method to its characterisation-model block (where applicable; inventory-only methods may not have one).

properties.label: has inventory indicator result
properties.comment: Sub-property of eudpp:hasLCAResult; range narrowed to eudpp:InventoryIndicatorResult.

properties.label: has issuer
properties.comment:
Linking DPP with its issuer (Actor from ACTOR module).

DPP is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.
Actor is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: has LCA result
properties.comment: Link from an LCAStudy (or its subclass EPDStudy) to one of its LCA results. Range is the abstract eudpp:LCAResult; sub-properties eudpp:hasLCIAResult and eudpp:hasInventoryResult narrow the result to the corresponding sibling subclass. Querying for eudpp:hasLCAResult retrieves both kinds of results in one go.

properties.label: has LCA study
properties.comment:
A product has a LCA Study -- a measurable outcome of a life cycle assessment, representing the quantified effect of a product.

Product is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.
LCAStudy is modelled in the EU DPP CO LCA module.

properties.label: has LCA verifier
properties.comment:
Links a review to the independent, third-party actor responsible for validating the Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) or Environmental Product Declaration (EPD).

Verifier means a person or organisation that carries out the independent verification of an EPD or LCA study, i.e. confirms through objective evidence that the specified requirements are fulfilled, e.g. the PCR and EN 15804+A2. It also covers the critical reviewer of an LCA study and the verifier of a PEF study. Independent verification may be internal or external; EPDs for business-to-consumer communication require third-party verification, also comparative assertions under ISO 14040 and any comparisons under the European Commission’s ILCD Handbook. The type of verification is recorded on the Review (TypeOfReview). ILCD: reviewer (1-3-20-87); [ISO 14025:2006, 3.8, adapted]

Review is modelled in the EU DPP CO LCA module. 
Actor is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: has LCIA result
properties.comment: Sub-property of eudpp:hasLCAResult; range narrowed to eudpp:LCIAResult.

properties.label: has license type
properties.comment: License applicable to the LCA / EPD study.

properties.label: has manufacturer
properties.comment:
A product has a manufacturer (Actor from ACTOR module).

Product is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.
Actor is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: has manufacturing site
properties.comment:
Links a manufacturer record to the facility it applies to, e.g., a production site covered by an LCA study or EPD. ILCD+EPD v1.3: manufacturer/sites/site.

ManufacturerRecord is modelled in the EU DPP CO LCA module.
Facility is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: has material
properties.comment:
Linking the Product to a MaterialOfComposition.

Product is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.
MaterialOfComposition is modelled in the EU DPP CO MAT module.

properties.label: has material identifier
properties.comment:
Realisation of the material identifier as "Product parameters: identification of  ... materials [ESPR Annex I c)]"

MaterialOfComposition is modelled in the EU DPP CO MAT module.
MaterialIdentifier is modelled in the EU DPP CO IDENT module.

properties.label: has material origin
properties.comment: Assigns material origin to material used for product

properties.label: has material type
properties.comment: Links material to its type in some classification system used by the sector.

properties.label: has measurement unit
properties.comment: Linking quantitative property to the unit of measurement.

properties.label: has next DPP
properties.comment: Link to successor DPP

properties.label: has notified body
properties.comment:
Specifies the conformity assessment body notified in accordance with ESPR Chapter IX	

EUDeclarationOfConformity is modelled in the EU DPP CO COMP module.
Actor is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: has per module value
properties.comment: Link from an LCAResult (LCIAResult or InventoryIndicatorResult) to one of its per-module (and optionally per-scenario) numerical values.

properties.label: Has preparation-for-reuse instruction
properties.comment: Links a substance presence to information relevant for preparation for reuse.

properties.label: has previous DPP
properties.comment: Link to predecessor DPP

properties.label: has product event
properties.comment: Links an EPCIS-inspired technical event carrier to the product event semantics it journalises.

properties.label: has product group
properties.comment:
Product group
means a set of products that serve similar purposes and are similar in terms of use, or have similar
functional properties, and are similar in terms of consumer perception (ESPR Art 2 (4)). The product
group or groups covered are given by delegated acts. (ESPR Art 8 (a))

This will be probably a classification code from some product classification scheme .

properties.label: has product status
properties.comment:
Links a Product to its current lifecycle status, as declared in its DPP.
It gives the current status only; the history of changes is represented with the events. 
Product status is distinct from DPP status (#dppStatus), i.e., the status of the passport.

Product is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.
ProductStatus is modelled in the EU DPP CO EVENT module.

properties.label: has property
properties.comment:
Product has a property that could be a document or some measurable properties (measurands).

Linking the product to the property.

properties.label: has qualification assertion
properties.comment: Links a substance of concern to a documented qualification assertion.

properties.label: Has recycling instruction
properties.comment: Links a substance presence to information relevant for recycling.

properties.label: has reference to background database
properties.comment: Link from an LCAStudy to a background LCI database used for the modelling (1..n). Sub-property of eudpp:hasExternalSource.

properties.label: has representative mandate
properties.comment: Relates a manufacturer to the mandate (assignment) that authorises an actor to act on the manufacturer's behalf.

properties.label: has responsible manufacturer
properties.comment:
Defines the natural or legal person responsible for the EU declaration of conformity.


EUDeclarationOfConformity is modelled in the EU DPP CO COMP module.
Actor is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: Has reuse instruction
properties.comment: Links a substance presence to information relevant for reuse.

properties.label: has review
properties.comment: Link from an LCAStudy to a critical-review / verification record.

properties.label: has role
properties.comment: Links an actor role assignment to a role.

properties.label: Has safe-use instruction
properties.comment: Links a substance presence to relevant instructions for the safe use of the product.

properties.label: has scheme
properties.comment: The scheme/standard the Identifier follows

properties.label: has SoC criterion
properties.comment: Links a qualification assertion to one or more non-exclusive criteria (a)-(d).

properties.label: has substance identifier
properties.comment:
Substance to an IDENT-owned SubstanceIdentifier link.

Substance is modelled in the EU DPP CO SOC module.
SubstanceIdentifier is modelled in the EU DPP CO IDENT module.

properties.label: has substance presence
properties.comment:
Relation from Product to contextual SubstancePresence.

Product is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.
SubstancePresence is modelled in the EU DPP CO IDENT module.

properties.label: has type of review
properties.comment: The kind of review performed (independent external, accredited third party, etc.).

properties.label: has Union Harmonisation Legislation
properties.comment: A property providing the Union Harmonisation Legislation refered to in the EU Declaration of Conformity.

properties.label: has unique facility identifier
properties.comment:
Linking a Facility to its unique facility identifier.
Facility is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.
FacilityIdentifier is modelled in the EU DPP CO IDENT module.

properties.label: has unique operator identifier
properties.comment:
Linking an Actor to their unique operator identifier. 
Actor is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.
ActorIdentifier is modelled in the EU DPP CO IDENT module.

properties.label: has unique product identifier
properties.comment:
Realisation of the uniqueProductIdentifier.

Product is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.
ProductIdentifier is modelled in the EU DPP CO IDENT module.

properties.label: identifier example value
properties.comment: Example value of the identifier

properties.label: identifier expires on
properties.comment: Identifier expiration date

properties.label: identifier issued on
properties.comment: Date of issuing the identifier

properties.label: identifier juristiction
properties.comment:
An optional property used to qualify the issuing country or territory required to disambiguate national registration numbers. 

Format: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, i.e., two-letter country code, such as FR for France, DE for Germany, EE for Estonia, etc.

properties.label: identifier maximum length
properties.comment: Maximum length of the identifier

properties.label: identifier minimum length
properties.comment: Minimum length of the identifier

properties.label: identifier pattern
properties.comment: A pattern the identifier conforms to, given as a regular expression (regex).

properties.label: identifier scheme issuer
properties.comment: Issuer of the identifier scheme

properties.label: identifier scheme version
properties.comment: Reference standard version the instance schema refers to

properties.label: identifier value
properties.comment: The (unique) value of the identifier.

properties.label: identifies data provider
properties.comment:
Identifies the entity that supplied or submitted the inventory data for this record, which may be different from the manufacturer (e.g., an industry association, a consultant, or a consortium lead for an average EPD).

ManufacturerRecord is modelled in the EU DPP CO LCA module.
Actor is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: identifies manufacturer
properties.comment:
Identifies the specific economic operator or manufacturing company whose production process and product are represented by this manufacturer record.

ManufacturerRecord is modelled in the EU DPP CO LCA module.
Actor is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: ILCD format version
properties.comment: ILCD schema version used by the source serialisation of this study (e.g. '1.1').

properties.label: includes method
properties.comment: Link from a Method (a collection of methods sharing a methodology such as "EF 3.1") to each of the individual-indicator method instances it aggregates.

properties.label: in context of DPP
properties.comment:
Relates the actor role assignment to a specific Digital Product Passport instance (from P_DPP module).

ActorRoleAssignment is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.
DPP is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.

properties.label: in context of product
properties.comment:
Relates the actor role assignment to a specific product (from P_DPP module).

ActorRoleAssignment is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.
Product is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.

properties.label: International name
properties.comment: An internationally recognised name for the substance, used when an IUPAC name is not available.

properties.label: is actor role assignment for event
properties.comment:
Links an actor-role assignment to the event context in which the role assignment applies. This is the inverse of evt:hasActorRoleAssignment and is managed in the Connector/mapping layer.

ESPREvent is modelled in the EU DPP CO EVENT module.
ActorRoleAssignment is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: is component of
properties.comment:
A product is a component of another product.

‘component’ means a product intended to be incorporated into another product; [ESPR Art 2(2)]

properties.label: is conform with
properties.comment: Specifies Union Harmonised Legislation for which conformity of the product is stated.

properties.label: is connected to
properties.comment:
A DPP is connected to a facility.

DPP is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.
Facility is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: critical raw material
properties.comment: Product parameters: use or content of recycled materials and recovery of materials, including critical raw materials; [ESPR Annex I h)]

properties.label: is declared
properties.comment: True if this module value is declared in the study (has a numerical amount), false if the module is explicitly marked as not declared (ND / MND) for this indicator/scenario. Absence of the LCIAModuleValue triple altogether means the module was not in scope of the study (MNA - module not applicable).

properties.label: is energy related Product
properties.comment:
Energy related product
means any product that has an impact on energy consumption during use. (ESPR Art 2 (4)).

The boolean data type property indicates is a Product energy related or not?

properties.label: is established in
properties.comment: Relates a legal person to the location where it is established.

properties.label: issued by
properties.comment:
Specifies the natural or legal person issuing the Declaration of Conformity; ESPR Annex V, paragraph 3 requirement: "This declaration of conformity is issued under the sole responsibility of the manufacturer:"


EUDeclarationOfConformity is modelled in the EU DPP CO COMP module.
Actor is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: is located in product
properties.comment:
Location of a substance presence in a product, component or spare part, connection between substance presence and product.

Product is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.
SubstancePresence is modelled in the EU DPP CO IDENT module.

properties.label: is notified for
properties.comment:
Specifies the conformity assessment activities, the conformity assessment module or modules and product or products concerned and the relevant attestation of competence	

UnionHarmonisationLegislation is modelled in the EU DPP CO COMP module.
Actor is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: is recorded as
properties.comment: Links a DPP event to a technical audit record representing its registration in an information system or audit trail.

properties.label: is replacable
properties.comment: Indicates whether the product (e.g. a component of another product) can be replaced.

properties.label: is represented by carrier
properties.comment: Links a product event concept to an EPCIS-inspired technical event carrier used to journalise and structure the corresponding event data.

properties.label: is residing in
properties.comment: Relates a natural person to the location where they reside.

properties.label: is role of
properties.comment: Relates role to an actor role assignment.

properties.label: is signed by
properties.comment:
Specifies the natural or legal person signing the Declaration of Conformity.


EUDeclarationOfConformity is modelled in the EU DPP CO COMP module.
Actor is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: is spare part of
properties.comment: A product is a spare part of another product.

properties.label: is substance presence of
properties.comment:
Inverse relation from SubstancePresence to Product.

Product is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.
SubstancePresence is modelled in the EU DPP CO IDENT module.

properties.label: issues certificate
properties.comment:
Specifies conformity assessment certificate issued for a certification.


ConformityCertificate is modelled in the EU DPP CO COMP module.
Actor is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: is triggered by product event
properties.comment: Links a DPP event to the product event that caused or required it. This property is used when the DPP event results from a lifecycle change affecting the product.

properties.label: is used by actor
properties.comment: Relates a facility to an actor.

properties.label: IUPAC name
properties.comment: The name of the substance in the International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry nomenclature.

properties.label: last update
properties.comment: The date and time of the latest update to the DPP instance.

properties.label: link to previous DPP
properties.comment: Where a new digital product passport is created for a product that already has a digital product passport, the new digital product passport shall be linked to the original digital product passport or passports. (ESPR Art 11 (d))

properties.label: manufacturing date
properties.comment:
Date of manufacture of the product. 

The range of the data property is intentionally left open to be specified in accordance of sectorial needs.

properties.label: part of product material is in
properties.comment:
The specific part of the Product this material belongs to. Description. 
For example, in case of a textile product: [Main, Lining, Filling].

properties.label: material component label
properties.comment:
Optional human-readable label identifying the role or part of the product associated with the material component (e.g. outer layer, lining, filling, casing).

Note: not defined by ESPR, requested by sectors (textile)

properties.label: recyclable material
properties.comment: Product parameters: design for recycling, ease and quality of recycling as expressed through use of easily recyclable materials [ESPR Art 5 (1n), Annex I d)]

properties.label: sustainale or renewable material
properties.comment: Product parameters: use or content of sustainable renewable materials; [ESPR Annex I i)]

properties.label: material percentage
properties.comment: Material percentage in a Product, e.g., mass fraction (percentage by weight).

properties.label: recycled content amount in material
properties.comment: Percentage of recycled content

properties.label: material recycled content type
properties.comment: Specifies the origin of recycled content: pre-consumer (manufacturing waste) or post-consumer (end-of-life waste), as required by regulatory differentiation.

properties.label: material type scheme
properties.comment: Reference system (e.g. ISO 11224, EU Textile Regulation 1007/2011 Annex I)

properties.label: material type value
properties.comment: Code or label in the chosen nomenclature (specified by #materialTypeScheme).

properties.label: Maximum numerical value
properties.comment: The upper bound of a concentration range.

properties.label: methodology version
properties.comment: Version identifier of an LCAMethodology individual (e.g. "3.1" for EF 3.1, "2002" for CML 2002).

properties.label: method version
properties.comment: Version of the specific LCIA or Inventory method instance (where applicable). Captures method-instance-level versioning, distinct from methodology-level versioning (eudpp:methodologyVersion on LCAMethodology).

properties.label: Minimum numerical value
properties.comment: The lower bound of a concentration range.

properties.label: model version
properties.comment: Version of the characterisation model used (e.g. "IPCC AR6 2021" vs "IPCC AR5 2013", which give different GWP100 values).

properties.label: numerical value
properties.comment: The numerical value of the quantity, i.e., quantitative property of the product.

properties.label: Other name
properties.comment: Another name used for the substance, including a usual name, trade name or abbreviation.

properties.label: performed assessment according to
properties.comment:
Specifies conformity assessment procedure/certification scheme performed by the notified body.


ConformityAssessmentModule is modelled in the EU DPP CO COMP module.
Actor is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: performed at
properties.comment:
Links a product event to the facility where the event was performed or operationally occurred. This is a cross-module relation between EVENT and ACTOR/Facility and is therefore managed in the Connector/mapping layer.

ProductEvent is modelled in the EU DPP CO EVENT module.
Facility is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: performed by
properties.comment:
Links a product event to the actor that performed, carried out, or was operationally responsible for the event. This is a cross-module relation between EVENT and ACTOR and is therefore managed in the Connector/mapping layer.

ProductEvent is modelled in the EU DPP CO EVENT module.
Actor is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: product image
properties.comment: An image of the product.

properties.label: product name
properties.comment: Product name

properties.label: product trade mark
properties.comment:
Trade marks identify goods or services as produced or marketed by a particular undertaking.

Trade mark required by ESPR Art 27(6), Art 29(3), Art 36 (1a).

When placing a product on the market, importers should indicate on the product their name, registered trade name or registered trade mark as well as the postal address at which and electronic means of communication through which they can be contacted. ESPR Preamble (64).

properties.label: provides LCA data
properties.comment: Indicates whether the manufacturer identified in this record directly provided primary LCA data for the study. Set to true for the reference manufacturer; may be false for manufacturers listed for traceability only.

properties.label: qualification note
properties.comment: Additional explanation or limitation of the qualification assertion.

properties.label: qualification valid from
properties.comment: First date on which the qualification assertion is considered valid.

properties.label: qualification valid until
properties.comment: Last date on which the qualification assertion is considered valid, when bounded.

properties.label: qualifies substance
properties.comment: Links a qualification assertion to the substance of concern that it positively qualifies.

properties.label: quantifies indicator
properties.comment:
Link from an LCAResult (LCIAResult or InventoryIndicatorResult) to the LCAIndicator individual that this result quantifies. 
This is the primary semantic identity of a result: a result is a quantification of an indicator, not of a method. 
Cardinality: exactly 1 per result instance.
Range: LCAIndicator (covers both EN15804Indicator individuals and non-EN-15804 indicators).

properties.label: recorded by
properties.comment:
Links a DPP event record to the actor that created the technical record of the logged DPP-side event. This is a cross-module relation between EVENT and ACTOR and is therefore managed in the Connector/mapping layer.

DPPEventRecord is modelled in the EU DPP CO EVENT module.
Actor is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.

properties.label: recorded in system
properties.comment: Indicates the URI identifying the system, application, or audit log in which the DPP event record is maintained.

properties.label: recorded in system name
properties.comment: Indicates the human-readable name of the system, application, or audit log in which the DPP event record is maintained.

properties.label: records DPP event
properties.comment: Links a DPP event record to the DPP event whose technical registration it captures.

properties.label: reference to complete review report
properties.comment: Link from a Review to the full review report.

properties.label: reference to compliance status
properties.comment: Level of compliance declared by a ComplianceDeclaration (fully compliant, partially compliant, or not compliant).

properties.label: reference to compliance system
properties.comment: Link from a ComplianceDeclaration to the standard or programme it references (EN 15804+A2, ISO 14025, ISO 21930, etc.).

properties.label: reference to external source
properties.comment: Link from a Method to the external documentation describing the method.

properties.label: reference to LCA method report
properties.comment: Link from a Method to the formal LCIA method report (e.g. the EF 3.1 method description).

properties.label: reference to model source
properties.comment: Link from an ImpactModel to the bibliographic source(s) describing the characterisation model.

properties.label: reference to original EPD
properties.comment: Link from the machine-readable EPDStudy to the published EPD document (typically PDF).

properties.label: reference year
properties.comment: Start year of the time period for which the study is valid.

properties.label: registered trade name
properties.comment: Trade name under which a legal person or business operates and is registered.

properties.label: registration number
properties.comment: Identifying number issued by the EPD programme operator (typically visible on the EPD document). Distinct from the dataset UUID.

properties.label: relates to LCA indicator
properties.comment:
Relates an EN15804 impact indicator to the conceptually corresponding EF 3.1 / PEF LCIA impact indicator. 
The two indicators are not equivalent — EN15804 indicators are EPD-specific reporting slots defined by EN15804+A2, while LCIA impact indicators follow the broader EF 3.1 characterisation framework. This property records a conceptual correspondence without implying any equivalence.

properties.label: represents manufacturer
properties.comment: Used when the role is authorisedRepresentativeRole to indicate the manufacturer being represented.

properties.label: represents manufacturer for product
properties.comment:
Indicates which product(s) the authorised representative's mandate covers.

AuthorisedRepresentativeRoleAssignment is modelled in the EU DPP CO ACTOR module.
Product is modelled in the EU DPP CO P_DPP module.

properties.label: review date
properties.comment: Date on which the review was completed. Important for DPP consumers to assess whether the review is still current.

properties.label: Location description
properties.comment: A textual description of the location of the substance within the product, used where the location cannot be represented solely by linking to a product, component or spare part.

properties.label: tolerance
properties.comment:
Engineering tolerance is the permissible variation in measurements deriving from the base measurement.
Tolerances can apply to many different units.

properties.label: Trade name
properties.comment: A trade name under which the substance is known.

properties.label: triggers DPP event
properties.comment: Links a product event to a DPP event that is triggered as a consequence of it, reflecting the obligation to update the DPP following lifecycle changes of the product.

properties.label: used for presumtion of conformity
properties.comment: This property specifies which harmonised standards (or parts thereof) was used to assess conformity with the Union harmonistation legislation.
properties.source:
https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/dec/2008/768(1)/oj#anx_I	
Decision No 768/2008/EC Annex I Art R8

properties.label: uses facility
properties.comment: Relates an actor to facility.

properties.label: Usual name
properties.comment: A usual name under which the substance is known.

properties.label: UUID
properties.comment: The Universally Unique Identifier of this LCA / EPD study, as mandated by ILCD+EPD as the primary persistent identifier. Once a study is created and a UUID is generated, the UUID stays the same forever; any change increments eudpp:dataSetVersion. String formatted as an RFC 4122 UUID (36 characters, hyphenated).

properties.label: valid from
properties.comment: The date and timestamp that the DPP is valid from.

properties.label: valid until
properties.comment: The date and timestamp that the DPP is valid until.

properties.label: value related to the document
properties.comment:
Contains the data of the value encapsulated in the Document.

Value is xsd:string that is formatted as a URL,  where to fetch the file.

properties.label: weblink
properties.comment: Web link to an instruction document or video etc.

enumerations.label: Actor identifier scheme
enumerations.comment: A kind of identifier scheme. The scheme or standard used to identify Actors. e.g., GLN, LEI, etc.

values.label: GLN
values.comment:
A globally unique identifier defined by GS1 used to identify legal entities, functional entities, and physical locations within business and supply chain processes.

Typically identifies: legal entities, functional entities (departments), physical locations (warehouses, sites).

values.label: LEI
values.comment:
A Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) is a globally unique 20-character alphanumeric code that identifies legally distinct entities participating in financial transactions, as defined by ISO 17442.

A 20‑character code used globally for financial and regulatory reporting.
Required for companies involved in financial transactions.
Used by regulators, banks, customs, and some trade systems.

enumerations.label: Area of Protection
enumerations.comment: Damage area addressed by an LCIA method via the LCIA Impact Category class using the addressesAoP object property. A closed enumeration of 5 individuals.

enumerations.label: Authority role
enumerations.comment: Parent class for roles of authorities, such as market surveillance authority, customs authority, etc.

values.label: Customs Authority
values.comment: Customs authorities means  customs authorities as defined in point 1 of Article 5 of Regulation (EU) No 952/2013; [Regulation (EU) 2019/1020, Art 3 (24)]

values.label: Market Surveillance Authority
values.comment: Market surveillance authority means an authority designated by a Member State under Article 10 as responsible for carrying out market surveillance in the territory of that Member State; [Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 Art 3 (4)]

enumerations.label: Circular economy role
enumerations.comment: Parent class for roles related to circular economy, such as remanufacturer, refurbisher, etc.

values.label: Independent Operator
values.comment: Independent operator means natural or legal person that is independent of the manufacturer and is directly or indirectly involved in the refurbishment, repair, maintenance or repurposing of a product, and includes waste management operators, refurbishers, repairers, manufacturers or distributors of repair equipment, tools or spare parts, as well as publishers of technical information, operators offering inspection and testing services and operators offering training for installers, manufacturers and repairers of equipment; [ESPR Art 2 (47)]

values.label: Professional Repairer
values.comment: Professional repairer means a natural or legal person that provides professional repair or maintenance services for a product, irrespective of whether that person acts within the manufacturer’s distribution system or independently; [ESPR Art 2 (48)]

values.label: Recycler
values.comment: An actor performing recycling, which means "any recovery operation by which waste materials are reprocessed into products, materials or substances whether for the original or other purposes. It includes the reprocessing of organic material but does not include energy recovery and the reprocessing into materials that are to be used as fuels or for backfilling operations" [WFD Art 3 (17)]

values.label: Refurbisher
