values.comment: An actor performing refurbishment, which means "actions carried out to prepare, clean, test, service and, where necessary, repair a product or a discarded product in order to restore its performance or functionality within the intended use and range of performance originally conceived at the design stage at the time of the placing of the product on the market."; [ESPR Art 2 (18)]

values.label: Remanufacturer
values.comment: An actor performing remanufacturing, which means "actions through which a new product is produced from objects that are waste, products or components and through which at least one change is made that substantially affects the safety, performance, purpose or type of the product"; [ESPR Art 2 (16)]

enumerations.label: Compliance Status
enumerations.comment: Level of compliance declared by a ComplianceDeclaration relative to its compliance system. Enumeration of 3 named individuals (fullyCompliant, partiallyCompliant, notCompliant).

values.label: Fully compliant
values.comment: The EPD study is declared fully compliant with the referenced compliance system.

values.label: Not compliant
values.comment: The EPD study is declared not compliant with the referenced compliance system.

values.label: Partially compliant
values.comment: The EPD study is declared partially compliant with the referenced compliance system; deviations should be documented on the associated review or in accessRestrictions.

enumerations.label: Conformity Assessment Module
enumerations.comment: Conformity Assessment module means the possible conformity assessment elements that can be chosen, in accordance with certain criteria, to fullfill the conformity accessement required to be performed by Community harmonisation legislation in respect of a particular product.

values.label: module A
values.comment:
Decision No 768/2008/EC module A

Internal production control

values.label: module A1
values.comment:
Decision No 768/2008/EC module A1.

Internal production control plus supervised product testing

values.label: module A2
values.comment:
Decision No 768/2008/EC module A2

Internal production control plus supervised product checks at random intervals

values.label: module B
values.comment:
Decision No 768/2008/EC module B

EC-type examination

values.label: module C
values.comment:
Decision No 768/2008/EC module C

Conformity to type based on internal production control

values.label: module C1
values.comment:
Decision No 768/2008/EC module C1

Conformity to type based on internal production control plus supervised product testing

values.label: module C2
values.comment:
Decision No 768/2008/EC module C2

Conformity to type based on internal production control plus supervised product checks at random intervals

values.label: module D
values.comment:
Decision No 768/2008/EC module D

Conformity to EU-type based on quality assurance of the production process

values.label: module D1
values.comment:
Decision No 768/2008/EC module D1

Quality assurance of the production process

values.label: module E
values.comment:
Decision No 768/2008/EC module E

Conformity to EU-type based on product quality assurance

values.label: module E1
values.comment:
Decision No 768/2008/EC module E1

Quality assurance of final product inspection and testing

values.label: module F
values.comment:
Decision No 768/2008/EC module F

Conformity to EU-type based on product verification

values.label: module F1
values.comment:
Decision No 768/2008/EC module F1

Conformity based on product verification

values.label: module G
values.comment:
Decision No 768/2008/EC module G

Conformity based on unit verification

values.label: module H
values.comment:
Decision No 768/2008/EC moduleH

Conformity based on full quality assurance

values.label: module H1
values.comment:
Decision No 768/2008/EC module H1

Conformity based on full quality assurance plus design examination

enumerations.label: Conformity assessment role
enumerations.comment: Conformity assessment means the process demonstrating whether the ecodesign requirements set out in the relevant delegated acts adopted pursuant to Article 4 have been fulfilled; [ESPR Art 2 (51)]

values.label: Conformity Assessment Body
values.comment: Conformity assessment body means a body that performs conformity assessment activities including calibration, testing, certification and inspection; [ESPR Art 2 (52)]

values.label: Notified Body
values.comment: Notified body means a conformity assessment body notified in accordance with Chapter IX; [ESPR Art 2 (53)]

values.label: Criterion (a)
values.comment: The substance meets the relevant REACH Article 57 criteria and has been identified under Article 59(1).

values.label: Criterion (b)
values.comment: The substance has a harmonised CLP Annex VI Part 3 classification in one of the hazard classes or categories listed by ESPR Article 2(27)(b).

values.label: Criterion (c)
values.comment: The substance is regulated under Regulation (EU) 2019/1021 on persistent organic pollutants.

values.label: Criterion (d)
values.comment: The substance negatively affects reuse and recycling of materials in the product in which it is present.

values.label: SoC criterion scheme
values.comment: Legal qualification criteria corresponding to points (a)-(d) of ESPR Article 2(27). A substance may satisfy more than one criterion.

enumerations.label: DPP Action Type
enumerations.comment: A classification indicating the type of information-level action performed during a DPP update event.

values.label: add data
values.comment: Indicates that new information is added to the Digital Product Passport.

values.label: correct data
values.comment: Indicates that erroneous, inconsistent, or incomplete information in the Digital Product Passport is corrected.

values.label: delete data
values.comment: Indicates that information is removed from the Digital Product Passport.

values.label: modify data
values.comment: Indicates that existing information in the Digital Product Passport is modified.

enumerations.label: Economic operator role
enumerations.comment: Economic operator means the manufacturer, the authorised representative, the importer, the distributor, the dealer and the fulfilment service provider; [ESPR Art 2 (46)]

values.label: Authorised Representative
values.comment: Authorised representative means any natural or legal person established in the Union that has received a written mandate from the manufacturer to act on the manufacturer’s behalf in relation to specified tasks with regard to the manufacturer’s obligations under this Regulation; [ESPR Art 2 (43)]

values.label: Dealer
values.comment: Dealer means a distributor or any other natural or legal person that offers products for sale, hire or hire purchase, or that displays products, to end users in the course of a commercial activity, including through distance selling; and includes any natural or legal person that puts a product into service in the course of a commercial activity; [ESPR Art 2 (55)]

values.label: Distributor
values.comment: Distributor means any natural or legal person in the supply chain, other than the manufacturer or the importer, that makes a product available on the market; [ESPR Art 2 (45)]

values.label: Fulfilment Service Provider
values.comment: Fulfilment service provider means any natural or legal person offering, in the course of commercial activity, at least two of the following services: warehousing, packaging, addressing and dispatching, without having ownership of the products involved, excluding postal services as defined in point 1 of Article 2 of Directive 97/67/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council (31), parcel delivery services as defined in point 2 of Article 2 of Regulation (EU) 2018/644 of the European Parliament and of the Council (32), and any other postal services or freight transport services; [Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 Art 3 (11)].

values.label: Importer
values.comment: Importer means any natural or legal person established in the Union that places a product from a third country on the Union market; [ESPR Art 2 (44)]

values.label: Manufacturer
values.comment: Manufacturer means any natural or legal person that manufactures a product or that has a product designed or manufactured and markets that product under their name or trademark; [ESPR Art 2 (42)]

enumerations.label: EN 15804 Impact Indicator
enumerations.comment: An EN 15804+A2 characterised impact indicator (core set of 13 or the 6 additional "with caveats" indicators). Characterised via the EF 3.1 characterisation models. Results computed for this indicator are eudpp:LCIAResult instances.

values.label: ADPE - Abiotic Depletion Potential (elements, minerals and metals)
values.comment: Abiotic depletion potential for non-fossil resources (minerals and metals), in kg Sb-equivalent. Core EN 15804+A2 impact indicator.

values.label: ADPF - Abiotic Depletion Potential (fossil resources)
values.comment: Abiotic depletion potential for fossil resources, in MJ (net calorific value). Core EN 15804+A2 impact indicator.

values.label: AP - Acidification (accumulated exceedance)
values.comment: Acidification accumulated exceedance, in mol H+-equivalent. Core EN 15804+A2 impact indicator (note: unit change versus EN 15804+A1, which used kg SO2-eq).

values.label: EP-freshwater - Eutrophication (freshwater)
values.comment: Fraction of nutrients reaching freshwater end compartment, in kg P-equivalent. Core EN 15804+A2 impact indicator. ERRATUM: the published text of EN 15804:2012+A2:2019 states the unit as 'kg PO4-eq' for this indicator, but the characterisation factors used by the EF 3.1 implementation operate on phosphorus (P), so the correct unit when reporting results against EF 3.1 characterisation factors is 'kg P-eq'. This ontology adopts the corrected unit. See JRC / EPD programme clarifications for details.

values.label: EP-marine - Eutrophication (marine)
values.comment: Fraction of nutrients reaching marine end compartment, in kg N-equivalent. Core EN 15804+A2 impact indicator.

values.label: EP-terrestrial - Eutrophication (accumulated exceedance, terrestrial)
values.comment: Eutrophication accumulated exceedance for terrestrial compartments, in mol N-equivalent. Core EN 15804+A2 impact indicator.

values.label: ETP-fw - Potential comparative Toxic Unit for ecosystems (freshwater)
values.comment: Ecotoxicity freshwater, in CTUe (comparative toxic units for ecosystems). EN 15804+A2 indicator with caveat.

values.label: GWP-biogenic - Global Warming Potential (biogenic)
values.comment: Global Warming Potential for biogenic GHG emissions and removals, in kg CO2-equivalent. Core EN 15804+A2 impact indicator.

values.label: GWP-fossil - Global Warming Potential (fossil)
values.comment: Global Warming Potential for fossil-fuel-related GHG emissions, in kg CO2-equivalent. Core EN 15804+A2 impact indicator.

values.label: GWP-luluc - Global Warming Potential (land use and land use change)
values.comment: Global Warming Potential from land use and land-use-change emissions and removals, in kg CO2-equivalent. Core EN 15804+A2 impact indicator.

values.label: GWP-total - Global Warming Potential (total)
values.comment: Global Warming Potential including all GHG emissions and removals, expressed in kg CO2-equivalent. Core EN 15804+A2 impact indicator. Colloquially known as the carbon footprint of the product.

values.label: HTP-c - Potential comparative Toxic Unit for humans (cancer)
values.comment: Human toxicity, cancer effects, in CTUh. EN 15804+A2 indicator with caveat.

values.label: HTP-nc - Potential comparative Toxic Unit for humans (non-cancer)
values.comment: Human toxicity, non-cancer effects, in CTUh. EN 15804+A2 indicator with caveat.

values.label: IRP - Potential Human exposure efficiency relative to U235
values.comment: Ionising radiation, potential human exposure efficiency relative to U235, in kBq U235-eq. EN 15804+A2 indicator with caveat.

values.label: ODP - Depletion potential of the stratospheric ozone layer
values.comment: Ozone depletion potential, in kg CFC-11-equivalent. Core EN 15804+A2 impact indicator.

values.label: PM - Potential incidence of disease due to PM emissions
values.comment: Particulate-matter-related incidence of disease, in disease incidence. EN 15804+A2 indicator with caveat: to be reported with the standard caveat statement per EN 15804+A2 Table 4.

values.label: POCP - Formation potential of tropospheric ozone
values.comment: Photochemical ozone creation potential, in kg NMVOC-equivalent. Core EN 15804+A2 impact indicator.

values.label: SQP - Potential Soil Quality Index
values.comment: Soil quality (land use) index, dimensionless (Pt). EN 15804+A2 indicator with caveat.

values.label: WDP - Water (user) deprivation potential
values.comment: Deprivation-weighted water consumption, in m3 world-equivalent deprived. Core EN 15804+A2 impact indicator.

enumerations.label: EN 15804 Indicator Group
enumerations.comment: Grouping of the EN 15804+A2 indicators based on the printed standard's tables: core impact (Table 3), impact indicators with caveats (Table 4), resource use (Table 5 resource use), waste categories (Table 5 waste), output flows valorisation (Table 5 output flows), exported energy (Table 5 output flows). Enumeration of 6 named individuals.

values.label: core impact
values.comment: Core set of 13 characterised impact indicators mandatory for EN 15804+A2 EPDs (Table 3).

values.label: exported energy
values.comment: Exported-energy inventory indicators of EN 15804+A2 (electrical energy, thermal energy).

values.label: resource use
values.comment: Resource-use inventory indicators of EN 15804+A2 (primary energy, secondary materials, secondary fuels, water).

values.label: valorisation
values.comment: Valorisation-output inventory indicators of EN 15804+A2 (components for re-use, materials for recycling, materials for energy recovery).

values.label: waste
values.comment: Waste-output inventory indicators of EN 15804+A2 (hazardous, non-hazardous, radioactive waste disposed).

values.label: impact with caveats
values.comment: Additional 6 characterised impact indicators of EN 15804+A2 that must be reported with the standard caveat statement (Table 4).

enumerations.label: EN 15804 Inventory Indicator
enumerations.comment: An EN 15804+A2 inventory-level indicator (resource use, waste disposed, or output flow for valorisation / exported energy). Not characterised; value is an aggregated inventory quantity. Results computed for this indicator are eudpp:InventoryIndicatorResult instances.

values.label: CRU - Components for re-use
values.comment: Components for re-use, in kg. EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator (output flow - valorisation).

values.label: EEE - Exported electrical energy
values.comment: Exported electrical energy, in MJ per energy carrier. EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator (output flow - exported energy).

values.label: EET - Exported thermal energy
values.comment: Exported thermal energy, in MJ per energy carrier. EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator (output flow - exported energy).

values.label: FW - Net use of fresh water
values.comment: Net use of fresh water, in m3. EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator (resource use).

values.label: HWD - Hazardous waste disposed
values.comment: Hazardous waste disposed, in kg. EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator (output flow - waste).

values.label: MER - Materials for energy recovery
values.comment: Materials for energy recovery, in kg. EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator (output flow - valorisation).

values.label: MFR - Materials for recycling
values.comment: Materials for recycling, in kg. EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator (output flow - valorisation).

values.label: NHWD - Non-hazardous waste disposed
values.comment: Non-hazardous waste disposed, in kg. EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator (output flow - waste).

values.label: NRSF - Use of non-renewable secondary fuels
values.comment: Use of non-renewable secondary fuels, in MJ net calorific value. EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator (resource use).

values.label: PENRE - Use of non-renewable primary energy (excl. raw material)
values.comment: Use of non-renewable primary energy excluding non-renewable primary energy resources used as raw materials, in MJ net calorific value. EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator (resource use).

values.label: PENRM - Use of non-renewable primary energy resources used as raw materials
values.comment: Use of non-renewable primary energy resources used as raw materials, in MJ net calorific value. EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator (resource use).

values.label: PENRT - Total use of non-renewable primary energy resources
values.comment: Total use of non-renewable primary energy resources (PENRE + PENRM), in MJ net calorific value. EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator (resource use).

values.label: PERE - Use of renewable primary energy (excl. raw material)
values.comment: Use of renewable primary energy excluding renewable primary energy resources used as raw materials, in MJ net calorific value. EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator (resource use).

values.label: PERM - Use of renewable primary energy resources used as raw materials
values.comment: Use of renewable primary energy resources used as raw materials, in MJ net calorific value. EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator (resource use).

values.label: PERT - Total use of renewable primary energy resources
values.comment: Total use of renewable primary energy resources (PERE + PERM), in MJ net calorific value. EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator (resource use).

values.label: RSF - Use of renewable secondary fuels
values.comment: Use of renewable secondary fuels, in MJ net calorific value. EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator (resource use).

values.label: RWD - Radioactive waste disposed
values.comment: Radioactive waste disposed, in kg. EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator (output flow - waste).

values.label: SM - Use of secondary material
values.comment: Use of secondary material, in kg. EN 15804+A2 inventory indicator (resource use).

enumerations.label: End user role
enumerations.comment: Parent class for roles of end users, such as consumer, etc.

values.label: Consumer
values.comment: Consumer means any natural person who, in relation to contracts covered by Directive (EU) 2019/771, is acting for purposes which are outside that person's trade, business, craft or profession; [Directive (EU) 2019/771, Art 2 (2)]

values.label: Customer
values.comment: Customer means a natural or legal person that purchases, hires or receives a product for their own use whether or not acting for purposes which are outside their trade, business, craft or profession; [ESPR Art 2 (35)]

values.label: End User
values.comment: End user means any natural or legal person residing or established in the Union, to whom a product has been made available either as a consumer outside of any trade, business, craft or profession or as a professional end user in the course of its industrial or professional activities; [Regulation (EU) 2019/1020  Art 3 (21)]

enumerations.label: Environmental Footprint Score
enumerations.comment:
An aggregated single-score indicator computed as the normalised and weighted sum of a set of impact-category results. 
Holds one named individual eudpp:ind_EF_singleScore representing the EU Environmental Footprint single score (PEF score). The applied normalisation factors and weighting set are not modelled here as properties; they are determined by the active EF / PEF methodology version, which is resolvable via the study's eudpp:hasComplianceDeclaration link to a eudpp:ComplianceSystem source. 
Results computed for an EnvironmentalFootprintScore individual are eudpp:LCIAResult instances.

values.label: Environmental Footprint single score
values.comment: EU Environmental Footprint single score (also referred to as PEF score), computed as a normalised and weighted aggregate of the 16 EF impact-category results. Expressed in dimensionless points (Pt). The applied normalisation factors and weighting set are determined by the methodology version (e.g. EF 3.1 per JRC EUR 31414 EN), which is resolvable from the study via eudpp:hasComplianceDeclaration on its referenced eudpp:ComplianceSystem source.

enumerations.label: LCA Methodology
enumerations.comment:
A named, versioned LCA methodology (a coherent set of LCA methods sharing principles and a set of characterisation factors), to which one or more Method instances belong. 
Each individual SHOULD carry a skos:altLabel giving a short code (e.g. "EF 3.1") and eudpp:methodologyVersion giving the version identifier.

values.label: CML 2002
values.comment: CML-IA (Institute of Environmental Sciences, Leiden University) baseline 2002 methodology. Used by EN 15804+A1 (predecessor of +A2).

values.label: Environmental Footprint 3.0
values.comment: European Commission Environmental Footprint method, version 3.0. Predecessor of EF 3.1; some characterisation factors differ.

values.label: Environmental Footprint 3.1
values.comment: European Commission Environmental Footprint method, version 3.1. Mandated by EN 15804+A2 as the characterisation basis for the 13 core and 6 with-caveat impact indicators.

values.label: EN 15804+A2 inventory calculation rules
values.comment: Inventory calculation rules defined by EN 15804+A2 itself for the 18 resource-use / waste / output-flow inventory indicators (PERE, PERM, ... EEE, EET). This "methodology" is inventory-level rather than characterised; it is distinguished here from EF 3.1 because the inventory indicators do not use EF characterisation factors.

values.label: IPCC AR6 (GWP)
values.comment: IPCC Sixth Assessment Report (2021) global-warming-potential characterisation factors, 100-year time horizon.

values.label: ReCiPe 2016
values.comment: ReCiPe methodology version 2016 (midpoint and endpoint). Not used by EN 15804+A2 but frequently used for non-construction-products LCAs.

enumerations.label: LCIA Impact Category
enumerations.comment: A mid-point impact category that an LCAMethod addresses. A closed enumeration.

values.label: Ionising radiation, ecosystems
values.comment: Ionising radiation on ecosystems. Note: EN 15804+A2 does not mandate an ecosystems-level ionising-radiation indicator (only IRP for human health). This impact category is retained for ILCD completeness; no EN 15804+A2 indicator individual maps to it.

enumerations.label: LCIA Impact Indicator
enumerations.comment:
A characterised impact indicator outside the EN 15804+A2 selection — direct subclass of eudpp:LCAIndicator, sibling of eudpp:EN15804Indicator. Holds the 16 official EF 3.1 / PEF impact category indicators as named individuals (Andreasi Bassi et al., JRC, 2023). 
These are the impact indicators used by general LCA studies (eudpp:LCAStudy) following the EU Environmental Footprint method, distinct from the EN 15804+A2 set used by EPDStudy. 
The two sets overlap conceptually — both have e.g. a "Climate change" indicator with kg CO2-eq — but differ operationally: EN 15804+A2 splits Climate change into four sub-indicators (total, fossil, biogenic, luluc) and selects 6 "with caveats" indicators with EN-specific reporting rules; EF 3.1 keeps Climate change as one indicator and presents 16 categories at one aggregation level.

values.label: Acidification EF
values.comment: Accumulated exceedance, in mol H+-equivalent. EF 3.1 / PEF impact category.

values.label: Climate change EF
values.comment: Radiative forcing as global warming potential, GWP100, expressed in kg CO2-equivalent. Aggregate of climate-change effects from fossil, biogenic and land-use-and-land-use-change sources. EF 3.1 / PEF impact category. Colloquially known as the carbon footprint of the product. JRC characterisation factors per EUR 31414 EN (2023).

values.label: Ecotoxicity, freshwater
values.comment: Comparative toxic unit for ecosystems (freshwater), in CTUe. EF 3.1 / PEF impact category.

values.label: Eutrophication, freshwater
values.comment: Fraction of nutrients reaching the freshwater end compartment, in kg P-equivalent. EF 3.1 / PEF impact category.

values.label: Eutrophication, marine
values.comment: Fraction of nutrients reaching the marine end compartment, in kg N-equivalent. EF 3.1 / PEF impact category.

values.label: Eutrophication, terrestrial
values.comment: Accumulated exceedance for terrestrial compartments, in mol N-equivalent. EF 3.1 / PEF impact category.

values.label: Human toxicity, cancer
values.comment: Human toxicity, cancer effects, in CTUh (comparative toxic unit for humans). EF 3.1 / PEF impact category.

values.label: Human toxicity, non-cancer
values.comment: Human toxicity, non-cancer effects, in CTUh. EF 3.1 / PEF impact category.

values.label: Ionising radiation, human health EF
values.comment: Human exposure efficiency to ionising radiation, relative to U-235, in kBq U235-equivalent. EF 3.1 / PEF impact category.

values.label: Land use
values.comment: Soil quality index, dimensionless (Pt), aggregating biotic production, erosion resistance, mechanical filtration and groundwater replenishment. EF 3.1 / PEF impact category.

values.label: Ozone depletion EF
values.comment: Ozone depletion potential (ODP), in kg CFC-11-equivalent. EF 3.1 / PEF impact category.

values.label: Particulate matter
values.comment: Impact on human health from fine particulate matter, in disease incidence. EF 3.1 / PEF impact category.

values.label: Photochemical ozone formation, human health
values.comment: Tropospheric ozone concentration increase, photochemical ozone formation potential, in kg NMVOC-equivalent. EF 3.1 / PEF impact category.

values.label: Resource use, fossils
values.comment: Abiotic resource depletion of fossil fuels (ADP-fossil), in MJ. EF 3.1 / PEF impact category.

values.label: Resource use, minerals and metals EF
values.comment: Abiotic resource depletion (ADP) of mineral and metal resources, in kg Sb-equivalent. EF 3.1 / PEF impact category.

values.label: Water use
values.comment: Weighted user deprivation potential, in m3 world-equivalent. EF 3.1 / PEF impact category.

Note that moduleA1A3 (aggregated product stage) is an alternative reporting form of A1+A2+A3; an EPD that reports A1-A3 should not additionally report A1, A2, A3 separately for the same indicator/scenario.

enumerations.label: Product identifier granularity
enumerations.comment: The granularity level (batch, item, model) at which the product identifier represents the product.

values.label: batch
values.comment:
According to ESPR Art 9 (2d) the digital product passport is to be established at model, batch or item level, and the definition of such levels is given by delegated acts;

The term ‘batch’ usually refers to a subset of a specific model composed of all products produced in a specific manufacturing plant at a specific moment in time (ESPR preamble (33)).

values.label: item
values.comment:
According to ESPR Art 9 (2d) the digital product passport is to be established at model, batch or item level, and the definition of such levels is given by delegated acts;

The term ‘item’ usually refers to a single unit of a model (ESPR preamble (33)).

values.label: model
values.comment:
According to ESPR Art 9 (2d) the digital product passport is to be established at model, batch or item level, and the definition of such levels is given by delegated acts;

The term ‘model’ usually refers to a version of a product of which all units share the same technical characteristics relevant for the ecodesign requirements and the same model identifier (ESPR preamble (33)).

enumerations.label: Product identifier scheme
enumerations.comment: A kind of identifier scheme. The scheme or standard used to identify Products, e.g., GTIN, SKU, etc.

values.label: GTIN
values.comment: A globally unique identifier for trade items, defined by GS1, used to identify products at various packaging levels.

values.label: SKU
values.comment: A Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) is an internal identifier assigned by an organization to uniquely identify and track a product, item, or variant within its own inventory and management systems.

enumerations.label: Role
enumerations.comment: Role means a set of tasks typically performed by one actor. (e.g. Responsible Economic Operator, Independent operator); [CIRPASS-2 User Stories 3.1]

values.label: Credential Agency
values.comment: A legal person that provides (professional) credentials to parties, which may be used to make and verify a variety of claims in the DPP, (ESPR) Art. 11 last paragraph. For example, a credentials agency could certify a professional repairer and provide appropriate credentials for the DPP system; [CIRPASS-2 User Stories 3.1]

values.label: DPP Service Provider
values.comment: Digital product passport service provider means a natural or legal person that is an independent third-party authorised by the economic operator which places the product on the market or puts it into service and that processes the digital product passport data for that product for the purpose of making such data available to economic operators and other relevant actors with a right to access those data under this Regulation or other Union law; [ESPR Art 2 (32)]

values.label: Issuing Agency
values.comment: Issuing agency is a legal person that provides unique identifiers and data carriers Art 12 (4a). Under specific conditions, economic operators may perform the functions associated with an Issuing Agency; [ESPR Art 12 (4b)]

values.label: LCA or EPD verifier
values.comment: Verifier means a person or organisation that carries out the independent verification of an EPD or LCA study, i.e. confirms through objective evidence that the specified requirements are fulfilled, e.g. the PCR and EN 15804+A2. It also covers the critical reviewer of an LCA study and the verifier of a PEF study. Independent verification may be internal or external; EPDs for business-to-consumer communication require third-party verification, also comparative assertions under ISO 14040 and any comparisons under the European Commission’s ILCD Handbook. The type of verification is recorded on the Review (TypeOfReview). ILCD: reviewer (1-3-20-87); [ISO 14025:2006, 3.8, adapted]

enumerations.label: Unit of measurement
enumerations.comment:
Measurement unit defining the magnitude of the quantity in respect to the value.

values.label: mass fraction unit
values.comment: Project-managed measurement-unit convention for dimensionless mass fraction expressed as a decimal ratio of masses. Use dpp:numericalValue "0.001"^^xsd:decimal for 0.1 % by mass. This avoids encoding "w/w" in the unit symbol and may be replaced by an official SI Digital Framework PID if one becomes available.

values.label: EC
values.comment: EC number is a unique identification number assigned to a chemical substance in the European Union. It is used to identify substances in regulatory databases, safety data sheets (SDSs), and chemical legislation.

values.label: ECHA
values.comment: ECHA substance identification scheme refers to the approach used by the European Chemicals Agency (ECHA) to identify and distinguish chemical substances for regulatory purposes under EU chemicals legislation, particularly REACH.

enumerations.label: Type of Review
enumerations.comment: Kind of critical-review/verification performed on a dataset. Enumeration matching ILCD TypeOfReviewValues.

values.label: Accredited third party review
values.comment: Reviewer independent of the organisations involved and accredited by an independent accreditation body. Highest level acceptable for EN 15804+A2 compliance.

values.label: Dependent internal review
values.comment: Reviewer involved in data collection or modelling, or representing the process/product system. Not acceptable for EN 15804+A2 compliance.

values.label: Independent external review
values.comment: Reviewer independent of the organisations involved. Acceptable for EN 15804+A2 compliance.

values.label: Independent internal review
values.comment: Reviewer not involved in the work but belonging to the same organisation or legally linked organisation. Acceptable only for generic data per InData.

values.label: Independent review panel
values.comment: Panel of at least three independent internal or external reviewers, chaired by an independent external reviewer.

values.label: Not reviewed
values.comment: The dataset has not been reviewed.
